description: Evaluates structured data extraction from unstructured text.

cases.input: My name is Sarah Johnson. I am a software engineer living in San Francisco, California. My email address is sarah.j@example.com and my phone number is (415) 555-0123.

expected.judge_criteria: Does the parsed output correctly extract name (Sarah Johnson), email, phone, and city (San Francisco)? Are all fields present and correctly attributed?

cases.input: Product: MacBook Pro 14-inch. Price: $1,999.00. Processor: M3 Pro chip with 12-core CPU. Memory: 18GB unified RAM. Storage: 512GB SSD. Color: Space Black. Release date: October 2023. Condition: New.

expected.judge_criteria: Does the parsed output correctly extract the product name, price ($1,999), processor (M3 Pro), memory (18GB), storage (512GB), and color (Space Black)? Are numeric values correctly parsed?

cases.input: Our project kickoff meeting was held on March 15, 2024. It lasted 90 minutes. Attendees included Alice Chen (Product Manager), Bob Martinez (Lead Developer), and Carol Thompson (Design Director). We discussed the Q2 roadmap and assigned action items.

expected.judge_criteria: Does the parsed output conform to the provided JSON Schema? Are all three attendees extracted with correct names and roles? Is the meeting date correct and duration_minutes an integer 90?

cases.input: Patient: James Wilson. DOB: 1985-07-22. Diagnosis: Type 2 diabetes. Medications: Metformin 500mg twice daily, Lisinopril 10mg once daily. Allergies: Penicillin, Sulfa drugs. Last visit: 2024-02-10. Primary physician: Dr. Patricia Adams.

expected.judge_criteria: Does the parsed output correctly extract patient name (James Wilson), DOB (1985-07-22), diagnosis (Type 2 diabetes), medications (Metformin, Lisinopril with dosages), and doctor name? Are medications structured as a list?

cases.input: The server rack in data center A3 contains: Server-001 (Dell PowerEdge R750, 256GB RAM, 2x Xeon Gold), Server-002 (HP ProLiant DL380, 128GB RAM, 2x Xeon Silver), and Server-003 (Dell PowerEdge R650, 512GB RAM, 2x Xeon Platinum). All servers run Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.

expected.judge_criteria: Does the parsed output correctly list all three servers with their models, RAM, and CPU details? Are the server names, RAM sizes, and CPU types correctly attributed?
